title: an array of started Promises that is never awaited is refused at each started Promise
notes: specification/failures.mdx, 'Promise Semantics': 'Authored `.sm` code MUST consume Promise instances only through `await`.' 'Calls to Promise instance `.then()`, `.catch()`, or `.finally()` MUST be compile errors.' The over-correction guard for the case above: reading `started.length` is not consuming the work it holds, and fire-and-forget concurrency stays refused. Both started Promises are charged, at the calls that started them.
